title: Smoky Russian Cheese Fritters
description: A hearty and flavorful appetizer inspired by Russian cuisine, these fritters are packed with smoky cheese and perfect for a grill party.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the grated cheese, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour and bread crumbs to the egg mixture and stir until just combined.
Add the chopped onion to the egg mixture and stir until just combined.
Add the egg mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
When the oil is hot, add the fritters and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the fritters to a plate and serve hot.
Optional: Grill the fritters for an extra crispy exterior and smoky flavor.
